attempted_claim: Let (M,g)=Gamma\H^3 be a convex cocompact hyperbolic 3-manifold whose limit-set Hausdorff dimension satisfies delta(Gamma)>=1. Let Delta_g>=0 be the Laplace-Beltrami operator and e^{-it Delta_g} the Schrodinger propagator. Does the lossless local-in-time endpoint estimate ||e^{-it Delta_g} u_0||_{L^2_t([0,1]; L^6_x(M))} <= C(M) ||u_0||_{L^2(M)} hold for all u_0 in L^2(M)?
decisive_failure: The investigation could not resolve the endpoint bound in either direction within the pass: a proof needs a new 3D no-pressure endpoint theorem and a disproof needs a new quasimode construction, both beyond the available time and literature. The supporting computation is a model diagnostic, not a theorem.
